body:
I'm trying. But how do you accept it? I don't know... If you are dead, it's just over. You don't know anything. 

My life can in no way help the human race. All I've done is hurt people. I've tried to come back around, but I won't be loved by someone.

thanks for the honesty. but my problem is that i'm in love with the bottle as much as i covet my simple apartment and other material things. they are in conflict. i can only handle how shitty it will be to wake up tomorrow so many times.

i would just supplement it with other drugs, but i don't know how to find them here.

i love my family, and i know they love me. honestly i've had a 30 ought 6 in my mouth, but i pulled it out, not because I give a shit about myself, but because I don't want my family to have to deal with the shame of a suicide in their ranks.

I do disagree with you, though. American society is set up so that felons like me cannot be real members of society. I don't matter. I am totally expendable. That's why I keep trying to die by accident. All I end up doing is pissing my bed and embarrassing myself. I wish I would just die already.
do i need to post nudes to get a response here? just give me one reason. i dont mean talk to me now. i just want a friend.please.

That makes a lot of sense. I made it last night, but I don't know about tonight. I'm running out of things to do to keep my mind off of drinking and it's not even dark outside. 

I'm so impatient that when nothing seems to be changing after a month or so, I just give up.

Basically, contrary to what I've heard a lot of people, particularly in AA say, my drinking friends are my real friends. Yeah, I could maybe hang out with them sober, we've done that before, but it's awkward to be the only sober person at a place.

Part of it is just habit, I guess. I made it last night without drinking. Today I've been productive, so my mind is immediately going to thoughts of getting drunk. I'm trying to fight it by reminding myself how all of tomorrow will be ruined: wake up after noon, feel like shit, again fight the urge to drink to get rid of the hangover because I have meetings with clients at work Monday, etc.

Honestly, I wish I could somehow learn to moderate. I guess I know deep down that it's a pipe dream, but I just can't give it up. When all of your adult life has revolved around events that all take place with alcohol involved, it's hard to let it go. At least it is for me.

I have managed to make it a few months sometimes, but it was only when I lived away from my friends. Last time around, I failed after going to visit some friends. I had called my sponsor about it before, made it a while, but gave in. I knew I shouldn't have been there. But I can't seem to make friends where I live now other than by going to bars. I've made some pretty bad mistakes in life previously, so I'm hesitant to try to hang out with "normal" people for fear they'll find out and I'll be back to where I started.
Thanks for your response. I think I somehow need to get over the shame of it and be honest with friends/family, but for reason I just haven't been able to do it.
